params.reason: The water need at b13 (600 L) is partially addressed by operation-2, which is delivering 300 L. According to the latest inventory lookup, only 300 L of water were available in total, leaving no further stock to satisfy the remaining 300 L demand. Regarding the shelter need at b2, facility b13 is a viable candidate with sufficient capacity (300 places), but it cannot be activated as a shelter because the organization lacks the required dependencies: only 1 of 2 required staff members is available, and there is no available energy or sanitation resource. No peer offers or alternative resources were found.
